summary: I read the full bundle and inspected the changed Rust sources, tests, fixtures, and docs with read-only tools. I did not run any tests or commands. The patch fixes real released defects: the quadratic line-prefix rescan, digit-separator handling, ordinary `signals:`/`slots:` labels, runtime macro call loss, directive spans, same-line QML ownership, and the missing Q_PROPERTY attribute values. Those fixes read as correct. The patch also introduces three regressions that no test or fixture covers: (1) `Q_NULLPTR` is now blanked in every position, so `= Q_NULLPTR` defaults and comparisons become parse errors; (2) the new `object_symbols` interval index ranks Class rows above Field rows, so `parent.x` and `this.x` bindings resolve against the nearest component instead of the enclosing object row and can emit false `uses` edges; (3) the macro allowlist drops declaration-position macros the released scanner handled (`Q_ALWAYS_INLINE`, `Q_NODISCARD_CTOR`, `Q_REVISION(...)`, `Q_ENUMS`, `Q_OBJECT_BINDABLE_PROPERTY`, `QT_WARNING_*`, `QT_FORWARD_DECLARE_CLASS`, `Q_GLOBAL_STATIC_WITH_ARGS`, `Q_LOGGING_CATEGORY`), and only the Kirigami corpus was re-verified. Two contract items also need attention: visible output changes are not declared in the output-change ledger while the crate version stays 3.3.0, and the QML doc removed a same-line limit that `declaring_class_symbol` still has. Measured tradeoffs are honestly recorded: Qt C++ p95 0.77s to 0.86s and QML 1.22s to 1.25s, with the 10k-member one-line header improving 3.46s to 2.24s.

findings.title: Q_NULLPTR is now blanked in every position and breaks ordinary C++ expressions
findings.body: `identifier` blanks `Q_NULLPTR` unconditionally (qt_macros.rs:289-292). The released scanner only blanked it in a line-leading terminal position through the specifier-prefix rule. With this patch `explicit Foo(QObject *parent = Q_NULLPTR);` becomes `parent =          );`, and `if (p != Q_NULLPTR)` or `x = Q_NULLPTR;` lose their right-hand operand. tree-sitter-cpp reports an error for each. Qt4/5-era KDE code uses `= Q_NULLPTR` defaults widely. The only test is the initializer-list probe (tests/cpp/qt_macros.rs:726-762); no test covers a mid-line use, and the Kirigami corpus uses `nullptr`, so the corpus run cannot see it.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite `Q_NULLPTR` to `nullptr` padded with two spaces (same 9-byte length) in `blank_macros`, or restore the released position rule. Add a test with `QObject *parent = Q_NULLPTR` in a parameter list and assert no parse diagnostics.

findings.title: object_symbols index never returns a Field row, so parent/this bindings resolve to the wrong scope
findings.body: `extract_relationships` builds `object_symbols` over Class and Field rows (relationships.rs:26-30) and `find_enclosing_symbol` queries it with `ContainingSymbolIndex::find` (relationships.rs:583-600). `is_better_containing_symbol` compares priority before size (containing_symbol_index.rs:203-217), and `symbol_priority` gives Class 2 and Field 5 (219-227). The root Class row spans the whole file, so the query always returns a Class and never the enclosing object row. `property_binding_scope` (482-504) uses this for `parent` receivers and non-identifier receivers. Example: `Item { property int gap: 100; Column { property int gap: 50; Rectangle { height: parent.gap } } }`. The released code scoped `parent.gap` to the Column row and found Column's `gap`; this patch scopes it to the root and emits a false `uses` edge to the root's `gap`. The existing test `a_parent_receiver_resolves_outside_the_enclosing_object` (tests/qml/relationships.rs:1067-1092) only covers a parent that is the root, so it passes by coincidence.
findings.recommendation: Object rows are created from the same `ui_object_definition` node, so look them up by exact `start_byte` in a HashMap built once (with the `ui_inline_component` anchor for inline bodies), and keep the interval index only for `class_symbols`. Add a two-level `parent.x` test where the parent is a nested object with a same-named property on the root.

findings.title: Macro allowlist drops declaration-position macros the released scanner handled
findings.body: `is_qt_macro_name` now accepts only `DECLARATION_MACROS`, `MEMBER_PREFIX_MACROS`, and the `Q_DECLARE_`, `Q_DISABLE_`, `QML_` prefixes (qt_macros.rs:43-75, 354-360). The released rule accepted any all-caps `Q_`/`QT_`/`QML_` name and blanked it when a declaration followed (299-308). The following common Qt macros no longer match and are left for the grammar: `Q_ALWAYS_INLINE void f();`, `Q_NODISCARD_CTOR explicit Foo();`, `Q_IMPLICIT Foo(int);`, `Q_REVISION(2, 1) void f();`, `Q_ENUMS(Mode)`, `Q_PRIVATE_SLOT(...)`, `Q_OBJECT_BINDABLE_PROPERTY(...)`, `Q_MOC_INCLUDE(...)`, file-scope `QT_WARNING_PUSH`/`QT_WARNING_POP`, `QT_FORWARD_DECLARE_CLASS(X)`, `QT_REQUIRE_CONFIG(x)`, `Q_LOGGING_CATEGORY(...)`, and `Q_GLOBAL_STATIC_WITH_ARGS(...)` (`Q_GLOBAL_STATIC` is an exact-match entry only). Each of these produces a parse error where the released binary parsed cleanly. docs/languages/cpp-qt.md:192-193 still states that `Q_OBJECT_BINDABLE_PROPERTY(...)` is blanked, which is now false. The branch re-ran only the Kirigami C++ corpus (102 files); the plasma-workspace corpus cited in the release notes was not re-run.
findings.recommendation: Keep the released broad name rule and add a short runtime denylist (`Q_ASSERT`, `Q_ASSERT_X`, `Q_CHECK_PTR`, `Q_ASSUME`, `Q_UNREACHABLE`, `Q_D`, `Q_Q`, `Q_LIKELY`, `Q_UNLIKELY`, `Q_FOREACH`) so nested calls survive while declaration macros stay covered. Add scan tests for the macros listed above and re-run the plasma-workspace corpus before release.

findings.title: Visible output changes have no ledger entry and the crate version stays 3.3.0
findings.body: The CLI version is still 3.3.0 (crates/julie-extract-cli/Cargo.toml:3) and the patch does not touch docs/contracts/extraction-output-changes.md, whose top entry is `## 3.3.0`. The patch changes artifact output: five new optional `cpp.qt_property.v1` metadata keys (core.rs:117-121), new pending `calls` rows from handler contexts (qml/mod.rs:535-576, fixtures qml/qt_symbols and qml/cross_file), changed `.import` symbol ids because `stable_location_id` uses the span and the span end moved (qml_directives.rs:98, 187), and retained identifier rows for arguments of `Q_ASSERT`, `Q_D`, and `Q_UNUSED`. The ledger says a change must name itself before it merges, and `compat-check` keys on the current build version, so the existing 3.3.0 entry would let the gate pass without describing these changes.
findings.recommendation: Bump the crate version and add a `## <version>` ledger entry with `classification: compatible` that lists the new metadata keys, the handler pending rows, the directive id change, and the retained identifiers.

findings.title: declaring_class_symbol still matches by start line; the QML doc removed that limit
findings.body: `declaring_class_symbol` finds the Class row whose `start_line` equals the anchor line (relationships.rs:329-338). For `Item { component Detail: Item { } }` on one line the root Class is pushed first (qml/mod.rs:122-126) and wins, so the inline component's `extends` edge is attributed to the root. The patch deleted the `Known limits` paragraph in docs/languages/qml.md that described exactly this same-line attribution. Tests cover `an_inline_component_body_extends_its_base` and the same-line call-ownership cases, but no test covers a same-line inline component `extends` edge.
findings.recommendation: Match the Class row by `start_byte == anchor.start_byte()` (the row is created from that node at qml/mod.rs:330-332) or use `class_symbols.find(anchor)`, then add a same-line `extends` test. Otherwise restore the doc limit.

findings.title: Stale comments and a dead branch after the Q_DECL_EXPORT change; one doc limit is now false
findings.body: `is_declaration_attribute_macro` no longer excludes `Q_DECL_EXPORT`/`Q_DECL_IMPORT` (qt_macros.rs:365-368), but its doc comment (362-364) still says they keep the export handling. Line 289 now fires first, so the `is_export_macro_name` branch for those two names (392-395) is dead and their site kind changes from `Export` to `Prefix`/`Statement`. No consumer reads `MacroKind::Export` (qt.rs:102, 174), so output does not change. docs/languages/cpp-qt.md:194-195 still says a goto label named `signals` or `slots` in a function body is rewritten, which this patch fixed.
findings.recommendation: Update the comment, drop the dead `Q_DECL_EXPORT|Q_DECL_IMPORT` arm in `is_export_macro_name`, and correct the doc limit.

findings.title: New QML resolvers add linear symbol scans per call expression
findings.body: `receiver_can_resolve_locally` scans `symbols` for a shadowing Variable (relationships.rs:166-172) and for id rows (174-183); `symbol_is_visible_from_component` and `containing_component` scan `symbols` per parent hop (185-221); `find_containing_function` scans `symbols` per `function_declaration` ancestor (554-558). The walk runs twice per file (`extract_call_relationships` and `walk_for_pending_calls`). The released code did one `declares_id` scan per receiver call. This is a constant-factor cost, consistent with the measured Kirigami QML p95 move from 1.22s to 1.25s. The Qt C++ corpus p95 moved 0.77s to 0.86s and the performance JSON states no cause was isolated.
findings.recommendation: Build one `HashMap<&str, &Symbol>` by id per file and use it in `containing_component` and `symbol_is_visible_from_component`. Profile the Qt C++ path once to attribute the 12% p95 increase.

next_steps: Fix the unconditional Q_NULLPTR blanking (pad-rewrite to `nullptr` or restore the position rule) and add a parameter-default test.
Replace the object_symbols interval index with an exact start_byte lookup for object rows and add a two-level `parent.x` binding test.
Restore coverage for declaration-position Qt macros (broad name rule plus a runtime denylist) and re-run the plasma-workspace corpus.
Bump the crate version and add an extraction-output-changes ledger entry for the new metadata keys, handler pending rows, directive id change, and retained identifiers.
Make declaring_class_symbol byte-exact or restore the same-line limit in docs/languages/qml.md.
Refresh the stale qt_macros.rs comment, remove the dead export branch, and correct the cpp-qt.md goto-label limit.

evidence.observation: `if is_declaration_attribute_macro(word) || word == "Q_NULLPTR"` blanks Q_NULLPTR with no prefix or position guard; macro_extent yields a Prefix site when `);` follows, so `parent = Q_NULLPTR)` becomes `parent =          )`.
The only Q_NULLPTR test is the line-leading initializer-list probe; no test exercises `= Q_NULLPTR` in a parameter list or a comparison.
`is_better_containing_symbol` compares priority before size; `symbol_priority` maps Class to 2 and Field (default arm) to 5, so a Class always beats a Field that contains the same position.
`object_symbols` is a ContainingSymbolIndex over Class and Field rows, so `find` on it returns the smallest enclosing Class, never a Field, because the root Class spans the file.

`property_binding_scope` uses `find_enclosing_symbol(node, object_symbols)` for non-identifier receivers and for `parent`; the released version looked up the enclosing object row of kind Class or Field by start line.
`a_parent_receiver_resolves_outside_the_enclosing_object` only tests a parent that is the root class, so it cannot detect the Field-vs-Class scope change.

`is_qt_macro_name` is now an allowlist: DECLARATION_MACROS, MEMBER_PREFIX_MACROS, and the Q_DECLARE_/Q_DISABLE_/QML_ prefixes. `Q_GLOBAL_STATIC` is exact-match only; `Q_ALWAYS_INLINE`, `Q_REVISION`, `Q_ENUMS`, `Q_OBJECT_BINDABLE_PROPERTY`, `QT_WARNING_PUSH`, `QT_FORWARD_DECLARE_CLASS`, `Q_LOGGING_CATEGORY` no longer match.
The specifier-prefix rule that blanked a Prefix site when `declaration_follows` is only reachable through `is_qt_macro_name`, so member-prefix macros outside the allowlist are left in the source.

Known limits still say `Q_OBJECT_BINDABLE_PROPERTY(...)` is blanked and that a goto label named `signals`/`slots` in a function body is rewritten; the first is now false because of the allowlist, the second is fixed by this patch.
Doc comment says Q_DECL_EXPORT/Q_DECL_IMPORT keep export handling, but `is_declaration_attribute_macro` no longer excludes them; the export arm at 392-395 is unreachable for those names.
Consumers only branch on MacroKind::Statement, MacroKind::Section, and MacroKind::Prefix with names Q_INVOKABLE/Q_SIGNAL/Q_SLOT, so the Q_DECL_EXPORT kind change has no output effect.
Q_UNUSED rewrite blanks name through `(` and replaces the closing `)` with `;`; byte length and newlines are preserved, argument text stays for the grammar.

Class-body tracking pushes brace depth when `class`/`struct`/`union` follows an empty prefix or `{`, `}`, `;`, `>`, `export`, `typedef`; lowercase `signals`/`slots` require `class_brace_depths.last() == Some(&brace_depth)`. Logic is consistent with the new tests for namespace, template, and forward-declaration headers.
`line_prefix` now takes the precomputed line start and slices `content[line_start.max(consumed.min(index))..index].trim()`, which removes the per-identifier rposition rescan from byte zero.
`end_of_numeric_literal` consumes alphanumerics, `'` and `.`, so `1'000` no longer opens a character literal; it is used in both `scan` (174) and `matching_paren` (467).
REVISION handling splits `REVISION(` into two tokens and joins through the first token ending in `)`, producing `(2, 1)`; the signature keeps the original collapsed text, matching the fixture.
New Q_PROPERTY line is 131 bytes starting at column 4, consistent with expected.json end_column 135 and start_byte 540 / end_byte 671.

`end_byte` now uses `directive_text.len()` after `directive_without_comment`, so the recorded span and the blanked bytes exclude a trailing `//` comment; `stable_location_id` at line 98 therefore changes the import symbol id for such directives.

`find_containing_function` matches Function rows by `start_byte == parent.start_byte()`; Function rows are created from the `function_declaration` node (qml/mod.rs:396-398), so the match is exact for same-line functions.

Receiver resolution requires component visibility, rejects a Variable named like the receiver whose parent is the caller, and requires the id row to be visible from the caller component; parameters and locals are SymbolKind::Variable with the function as parent (javascript/parameters.rs:53, qml/locals.rs:72).

Pending walk now uses the shared caller and scope resolvers; handler-context calls that do not resolve locally produce structured pending rows, which matches the new `console.log` and `Helpers.label` rows in the QML goldens.
`declaring_class_symbol` still selects the first Class row whose start_line equals the anchor line; the root row is pushed before an inline component row on the same line.
version = "3.3.0" is unchanged while extraction output changes; the ledger's top entry is `## 3.3.0`, and the patch's file list does not include docs/contracts/extraction-output-changes.md.
The ledger requires one `## <version>` section per version whose extraction output changes, added before the change merges.
Five new optional string keys (designable, scriptable, stored, user, revision) are added to the cpp.qt_property.v1 pattern; docs/contracts/structural-fact-patterns.json mirrors them.
